newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU reviews Generali buy of Prime.
newsitem.headline: EU reviews Generali buy of Prime.

text.p: The European Commission said on Tuesday it was starting a preliminary review into the proposed takeover of Italian investment and life insurance firm Prime SpA by rival insurer Assicurazioni Generali SpA.

It said the deal was submitted for clearance on November 21 under the European Union's merger rules which ban creation or strengthening of dominant positions. The Commission has one month from that date to clear the operation or start a full, four-month probe.
Under the terms of the deal announced in October, Generali will acquire Fiat's 95.1 percent stake in Prime, one of Italy's biggest fund managers. -- Brussels newsroom 322 2876841
